question: When was the International Day for Elder Persons 2021 celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 October.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** International Day for Elder Persons** is observed on** October 1st **every year to raise awareness about the issues faced by older people and to celebrate their contributions to society.
 
• The year** 2021** has already passed and the International Day for Elder Persons was celebrated on **October 1st, 2021.**
 
• The International Day for Elder Persons was first observed in** 1991**, and its theme for 2021 was** "Digital Equity for All Ages."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2 October** is the date for the **International Day of Non-Violence.**
 
• It is observed on **Mahatma Gandhi's birthday.**
 
• In accordance with **United Nations General Assembly resolution** A/RES/61/271, it was founded on **June 15, 2007. **
